## About
Trust Auto Parts is a used auto parts store on Airline Dr in Houston. We sell used parts, including engines and transmissions, and we take the time to help you track down the right one for your vehicle.
Customers have rated us 4.2 on Google across 169 reviews. One reviewer said our prices were very reasonable compared to other places around Houston, and another told folks to come visit and ask for Oscar.
Whether you're picking up Silverado parts or need an engine shipped out, we'll answer your questions straight and get you moving.

## Services
- Used engine or transmission: Buy a used engine or transmission from us, described accurately so you know what you're getting.
- Transmission rebuilds: We rebuild transmissions. One customer brought in their Chevy Suburban for a rebuild.
- Parts pulled for you: Need a bigger job like a complete interior? We can pull the parts and help load them into your truck.

## FAQ
Q: Are you open on Saturday?
A: Yes. We're open Saturday from 8 AM to 7 PM, the same hours as Monday through Friday. We're closed on Sunday.

Q: Can you ship an engine to me?
A: Yes. One customer said their engine was shipped out the very next day after they bought it.

Q: What if you don't have the part I need?
A: Ask us. For one customer, we didn't have the ABS module they needed, so we kept an eye out for it.
